title: qc-triage-ledger record
description: Append-only JSONL record per classified QC failure (WD-rty2, ADOPT #7). One line per event; the file is append-only (retention=none, append anytime — same ruling as the insight ledger). No auto-rewriting of rules/docs from this ledger: it logs, a human decides.

event_id.description: Stable id of the source QC failure event.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the source event.

gate_id.description: The gate whose verdict produced the event (e.g. render_qc_threshold, language_gate, provenance_gate).

classification.description: The three-tier ladder class (changelog-design-rationale.md section B): fix/remove the gate / fix the material against a named rule / add or fix an exemplar.

confidence.description: Classifier confidence (deterministic heuristics only; ambiguous events are rejected, never recorded at low confidence).

evidence.description: Verbatim excerpt from the event (notes/critique) — evidence stays verbatim, never inferred.

action_taken.description: The HUMAN decision taken. There is deliberately no auto-rewrite action class (没有评测集的自动改文档就是瞎改).

follow_up_story.description: Story id tracking the fix (empty when none yet).
